name: llm_chat
description: Send a chat message to an LLM via z-agent-llm-gateway. Use this when the CEO agent needs to reason, analyze, summarize, or generate content using an LLM (e.g. analyze an opportunity, draft a report, classify a signal). Supports multi-provider routing (OpenAI/Claude/DeepSeek), function calling (tools), temperature/maxTokens control, and automatic usage recording. The response includes `content` (text), `usage` (input/output tokens), and `finishReason`. For streaming responses use llm_chat_async instead.

providerCode.description: LLM provider code. Examples: 'openai', 'claude', 'deepseek', 'qwen'. Use llm_list_providers to discover available providers first.

modelCode.description: Model code. Examples: 'gpt-4o-mini', 'claude-3-haiku', 'deepseek-chat', 'qwen-turbo'. Must be supported by the provider.

messages.description: Chat message history. Each message has 'role' (system/user/assistant) and 'content' (text). System messages set the persona/context.

role.description: Message role. 'system' for instructions, 'user' for user input, 'assistant' for model responses.

temperature.description: Sampling temperature. Range 0.0-2.0. Lower = more deterministic. Default 0.7. Use 0.0-0.3 for factual/Q&A tasks, 0.7-1.0 for creative tasks.

maxTokens.description: Maximum tokens in the response. Range 1-8000. Default 2000. Set lower for concise answers, higher for long outputs.

appCode.description: Application code for usage tracking. Default 'ceo-agent'.

userId.description: User ID for rate limiting and usage attribution. Default 'admin'.

tools.description: Function calling tools. Each tool has 'name', 'description', and 'parameters' (JSON Schema). The model will decide when to call a tool.

description.description: Natural-language description of what the tool does.

parameters.description: JSON Schema describing the tool's input parameters.
